planets.name: TOI-1411 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1411 with a 1.45-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1411 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1411. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
